default_rationale: Development winner for prepared eight-worker resident delivery; bounded large-queue heap behavior and no storage-copy demotion. Other measured presets remain selectable.
statistical_unit: Fresh process; frames within a process are not independent replicates
pairing: Same case, seed and repetition; shuffled candidate order within each group
confidence: Paired log-ratio bootstrap, 10000 resamples, 95 percent intervals; report each seed and pooled process pairs
proof_requirements: Exact complete per-recipient delivery vectors including handoff ticks, payload content and ordered events
Equal canonical checksum, delivered output count and offered input count across finalists for each case and seed
Final latest state acknowledged with no pending or in-flight records
Full expected process coverage without duplicate cells
Frozen executable and committed source hash verification
Uninstrumented speed builds; allocation-profile timings cannot enter speed acceptance
Current library tests, default-feature MSRV, formatting, clippy, standalone package and example checks
claim_rule: A speedup claim requires the paired interval upper bound below 1.0. Publish all wins, regressions and inconclusive cells. A unique fastest claim additionally requires beating every eligible finalist on that case and metric.
publication_scope: Generic Rust source and reproducible evidence on public GitHub. No registry publication, private game source or claim of all-world library superiority.
limitations: Short fixture frames do not prove sustained network p99
20000 in-process recipients do not prove 20000 live connections
Three external queue crates are component comparisons; cataloged full engines are not all benchmarked
